headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 22, 2026**
article:
The Cincinnati Reds secured a 4-1 victory over the New York Yankees, with Chase Burns earning the win after 5.0 IP, 7 K, 1 ER, 3 BB, 5 H. Tyler Stephenson led the Reds' offense with 1 H, 1 HR, and 3 RBI. The Milwaukee Brewers also secured a win, defeating the Atlanta Braves 9-4 behind Robert Gasser's 6.0 innings of work with 7 strikeouts.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Blas Castaño, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Colorado Rockies due to a right pectoral strain. Other notable injured players include Josh Ekness (Miami Marlins), Liam Hicks (Miami Marlins), Luis Severino (Athletics), Jack Leiter (Texas Rangers), Adley Rutschman (Baltimore Orioles), Blake Treinen (Los Angeles Dodgers), and Isiah Kiner-Falefa (Boston Red Sox).

The MLB trade market has been active, with several notable transactions taking place. The Washington Nationals traded RHP Tyler Schoff to the Atlanta Braves, while the Houston Astros traded RHP Jayden Murray to the Chicago Cubs for 1B Cameron Sisneros. The Arizona Diamondbacks traded SS Luis Urías to the Toronto Blue Jays for cash, and the Atlanta Braves traded RHP Hunter Stratton to the Pittsburgh Pirates for C Joey Bart.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Yankees 4-1**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a 4-1 victory over the New York Yankees, with Chase Burns earning the win after 5.0 IP, 7 K, 1 ER, 3 BB, 5 H. Tyler Stephenson led the Reds' offense with 1 H, 1 HR, and 3 RBI.

top_news.title: **Brewers Take Down Braves 9-4**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers secured a 9-4 victory over the Atlanta Braves, with Robert Gasser earning the win after pitching 6.0 innings with 7 strikeouts.

top_news.title: **Nationals Fall Short in Tampa**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals dropped a 3-4 decision to the Tampa Bay Rays, unable to overcome a late deficit. Jonny DeLuca led the Nationals' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, including a key 4th-inning homer that scored Yandy Díaz.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down White Sox in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers edged out the Chicago White Sox 5-4 in a close game. Dillon Dingler led the Tigers' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Mets Shut Down Cubs in Scoreless Tie**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured a 0-0 victory over the Chicago Cubs, marking a scoreless tie in the game. The Mets emerged as the winners, outlasting their opponents in a closely contested matchup.

top_news.title: **Rockies RHP Castaño Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Colorado Rockies right-hander Blas Castaño has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right pectoral strain, effective retroactive to June 18, 2026.

top_news.title: **Braves Bolster Bullpen with Trade Acquisition**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves have acquired right-handed pitcher Tyler Schoff from the Washington Nationals. Schoff joins the Braves' roster on June 20, 2026.
